name: B10-0132/2025 (PfE) – Repression by the Ortega-Murillo regime in Nicaragua, targeting human rights defenders, political opponents and religious communities in particular
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on repression by the Ortega-Murillo regime in Nicaragua, targeting human rights defenders, political opponents and religious communities in particular
part_text:
The European Parliament calls for the release of everyone held arbitrarily in Nicaragua and for their sentences to be cancelled. It condemns repression by the Ortega-Murillo government against Catholic Church members, other religious communities, political opponents and human rights defenders. It asks the Council to impose tougher sanctions on Ortega, Murillo and their allies, and to stop all EU financial aid to Nicaragua. It also asks the EU and its member states to support prosecutions of Ortega and Murillo for crimes against humanity. This is a statement of positions and requests; it does not itself change any law.

- The EU is asked to stop all financial aid to Nicaragua and impose tougher sanctions.
- It affects Nicaragua's rulers and their allies, and people detained there.
- Next, the Council decides whether to act on sanctions and aid.
